name: Falcon
caption: A three-time NICW World Champion, "The Bird of Prey" lost the title to challenger Mike D'Angelo in a thirty-minute Ironman main event, two falls to one.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'NICW Wrestlefest - RSP-WF Edition' main event (23 May 1996) and its own news bulletin (18 May 1996), which bills Falcon as a possible NICW departure after the show.

name: "Masta Ace" Mike D'Angelo
caption: Won his first title, the NICW World Heavyweight Championship, upsetting three-time champion Falcon two falls to one in a thirty-minute Ironman match.

tenures.role: wrestler -- NICW World Heavyweight Champion (1 reign)
tenures.source: The fed's own 'NICW Wrestlefest - RSP-WF Edition' main event (23 May 1996); subject of a separate four-part in-fiction career-tribute thread the same week (not served).

name: "The Unforgiven" David Pietka
caption: The NICW World Heavyweight Champion of the fed's own 1999 revival, undefeated at 6-0-0 by the promotion's own April rankings.

tenures.source: Billed the NICW World Heavyweight Champion (6-0-0) in the promotion's own "NICW Official Rankings" (21 April 1999).

name: Dr. Hate

tenures.source: Billed the NICW Transcontinental Champion (6-1-0) in the promotion's own "NICW Official Rankings" (21 April 1999).
